The estimated average treatment effect is about 3.83 cognitive-score points. I got this from an OLS regression of the outcome `y` on the treatment indicator plus all 25 covariates (747 children).

The unadjusted difference in mean outcomes between treated and control children is 3.84, almost the same. I used the covariate-adjusted figure because only 18.6% of the children are treated, so the groups may differ on the covariates. The regression assumes a single constant treatment effect and a linear effect of the covariates.

ANSWER: 3.83
